meaning: Experimental live microstructure observations, NOT predictions from the prospective model. Thresholds below are engineering defaults, not backtested or calibrated. No accuracy or lead-time claim. Does not replace or change orderbook_eval surge labels or evaluation candidate policy.
operations: One live process per checkout; persist per-symbol signal cooldown across restart, no automatic retry of ambiguous network failures. Signals require --signals; delivery requires --slack. Default mode only journals previews locally. Webhook lookup: explicit ORDERBOOK_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, else SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL*, else ~/.openclaw/.env.slack-surge. No daemon installed by running this program.
